title: Turkey & Cheese Roll-Ups
description: Sliced turkey breast wrapped around cheese sticks and fresh basil — a zero-prep protein snack.
steps: Lay out a turkey slice and spread with a little mustard.
Place a piece of string cheese and a basil leaf in the center.
Roll tightly, securing with a toothpick if needed.
notes: A genuinely zero-cook option for days you have no time — keep string cheese and sliced turkey on hand.
